integrations.name: Carrier API
integrations.purpose: Request rates, purchase labels, schedule pickups, and receive tracking updates from a shipping carrier.

provenance.notes: karrio's entire architecture is a carrier-abstraction layer over these APIs; single source inspected for models, the connector implementations themselves were not cloned.

integrations.name: Inbound webhook receiver
integrations.purpose: Receive asynchronous tracking/status push events from carriers or telematics providers.

provenance.notes: karrio's tracker update flow and fleetbase's fleetbase_device_events/fleetbase_api_events tables both imply an inbound event-ingestion surface.

integrations.name: E-commerce platform
integrations.purpose: Import orders that need to be shipped from a storefront or marketplace.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from karrio's orders module (Order.source field); single source, no specific e-commerce connector inspected.

integrations.name: Mapping and geocoding
integrations.purpose: Geocode addresses, compute distance/time between stops, and optimize or render routes.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_routes/fleetbase_waypoints store distance/time totals and GEOMETRY location columns consistent with a mapping provider; single source, no specific provider connector inspected.

integrations.name: Vehicle telematics
integrations.purpose: Ingest live vehicle location, speed, and diagnostic data from onboard hardware or OEM APIs.

integrations.name: Fuel card provider
integrations.purpose: Sync fuel purchase transactions per vehicle/driver from a fuel card network.

integrations.name: Payment gateway
integrations.purpose: Process cash-on-delivery reconciliation or freight payment collection.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_payloads.cod_payment_method column; single source, no specific gateway connector inspected.
